To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a trisomy of the proximal short arm of chromosome 17 was detected in an infant with multiple congenital malformations and IUGR.

a de novo supernumerary satellited marker chromosome 17 was identified in a fetus with IUGR, a trisomy for the short arm of chromosome 17 (17p) and a phenotype similar to previously described cases of ‘pure’ trisomy 18.
we have identified a fetus with a supernumerary satellited marker chromosome 17 and a phenotype consistent with trisomy 16p.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of a trisomic 17p in an IUGR fetus.
the identification of the marker chromosome and its origin.
the identification and characterization of a de novo supernumerary satellite‐like marker in a fetus with trisomy 20p.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this patient had a de novo nonmosaic trisomy 16pter→p11,2 derived from a satellited marker chromosome.
this is a case of trisomy for the distal short arm of chromosome 17, with a breakpoint in the proximal region of 17p11.2.
a trisomy for the 17p region was responsible for the clinical phenotype, but that other genetic and/or non‐genetic factors were also involved in the pathogenesis of this patient.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a trisomy of the 17p region is associated with a characteristic phenotype.
the prenatal identification of trisomy 16p by amniocentesis is possible, and that the prognosis of the fetus is poor.
the phenotype of a pure 17p trisomy is not uniform.
The main takeaway from our work is that
prenatal diagnosis of trisomy 18p should include FISH with probes for 18p and 17p to exclude the possibility of a de novo satellite marker chromosome.
the prenatal diagnosis of trisomy 18p is possible, even if a supernumerary marker chromosome is present, and that it can lead to the birth of a liveborn infant.
prenatal detection of satellited markers by FISH is a useful tool to diagnose trisomy of the short arm of chromosome 17.
